annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation may continue to transmit non-protected frames after packet protection is available, but it is discouraged.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation must stop transmitting non-protected frames after packet protection is available.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' creates ambiguity. It is unclear whether the implementation is required to stop transmitting non-protected frames or merely encouraged to do so. A 'MUST' would remove the ambiguity.
